_sample_note: Sample 06 (reference suite): ASN.1 BER ingestion of real GSMA TAP3 roaming records, all assets isolated in the {{catalog}}.flowx_sample schema. The ASN.1 module is the genuine GSMA TAP release 3.10 specification shipped in this repo at BT_Usecase/UC7/data/asn_schema/TAP.310.asn1 -- NOT a hand-written toy module (contrast flowx_testing/013_ing_004_asn1_decode.json, which uses the 5-field sample_data/asn1_schema/gsm_cdr.asn). The seed notebook (notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/04_seed_sample_06_asn1_tap3_data.py) copies that module verbatim into the sample landing Volume and BER-encodes every fixture ON-CLUSTER against the landed copy, so the compiled schema identity the seed encodes with is byte-identical to the one asn1_schema_path points the pipeline at. PDU CHOICE: 'Notification' -- TAP.310's DataInterChange is an ASN.1 CHOICE and TransferBatch reaches CallEventDetail (also a CHOICE), and asn1/decoder.py::derive_asn1_field_defs supports neither; Notification is a top-level [APPLICATION 2] SEQUENCE whose whole member tree resolves cleanly, and it is a real TAP3 file-level PDU (the notification file a roaming partner sends when it has no chargeable events to transfer). It exercises three Spark shapes at once: scalars (sender/recipient/fileSequenceNumber), a nested SEQUENCE -> struct (the three DateTimeLong timestamps), and a SEQUENCE OF -> array (operatorSpecInformation). Each iteration also lands 2 deliberately truncated .ber payloads so the decoder's per-row _asn1_decode_error capture is visible: they are quarantined into sample_tap3_notification_raw_quarantine rather than failing the micro-batch.

ingestion_flows.source_description: Sample 06: BER-encoded GSMA TAP release 3.10 Notification records (tap3_notification_iter<N>_<seq>.ber, built on-cluster by the seed notebook against the landed TAP.310.asn1 module) are read as binary by Auto Loader and decoded by asn1/decoder.py into sender/recipient/fileSequenceNumber scalars, three DateTimeLong structs, and the operatorSpecInformation array. Each iteration also lands 2 truncated payloads whose _asn1_decode_error routes them to sample_tap3_notification_raw_quarantine.

rules.expression: sender IS NOT NULL AND sender <> ''
fileSequenceNumber IS NOT NULL AND fileSequenceNumber <> ''
